prompt: Add a browser integration test in `tests/admin_views/test_collapsible_fieldset.py`: on the change form of `Article` in the admin, clicking the summary of the collapsed `Advanced options` fieldset opens it. Write it the way our contributing docs describe for tests that need a browser. This is a trimmed extract of Django that cannot run on its own, so do not try to run it. Keep the change small and tell me briefly what you did.
decision: Django's integration tests moved from Selenium to Playwright, and `django.test.selenium` was removed.
difference: imports Selenium or a Selenium test base class (old) against imports Playwright or a Playwright test base class (new)

old.docs/releases/6.2.txt: says django.test.selenium was removed; it is counted under the new rule
old.docs/ref/contrib/staticfiles.txt: names Selenium in passing as one example of a browser tool

weak_points: The user-facing testing guide at the pinned commit still teaches `LiveServerTestCase` with a full Selenium example, and it is meant for Django users, not for Django's own suite. It is left in place and counted as contamination. A run that follows it lands on `old` for a reason other than the staged old revision.

separation.why: Each revision names one tool and never the other. A user-facing guide outside the pair still teaches Selenium; see the contamination count.
